title: Step 1 - Building a Support Vector Machine Model with Scikit-learn in Python

cues.en: Instructor: Hello my friends, and welcome to this new practical activity on support vector machines.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到新的支援向量機實作活動。

cues.en: All right, so we already built two classification models logistic regression, and K and N.
cues.zh: 好，我們已經建立了兩個分類模型：邏輯斯迴歸與 KNN。

cues.en: We got the best results so far with K and N and now let's see if SVM can beat it.
cues.zh: 到目前為止 KNN 的結果最好，現在看看 SVM 能否超越它。

cues.en: All right, so before we start, as usual let's make sure everyone here is on the same page, and if that's the case, then follow me into Part 3 - Classification, and then section 16 Support Vector Machine (SVM).
cues.zh: 開始前，一樣先確認大家進度一致。準備好了就跟我進入 Part 3 - Classification，再進入第 16 節 Support Vector Machine (SVM)。

cues.en: And we're gonna start with Python, of course, as usual.
cues.zh: 當然一樣先從 Python 開始。

cues.en: And in this Python folder you will get two files.
cues.zh: 這個 Python 資料夾中會有兩個檔案。

cues.en: The first is the same dataset Social_Network_Ads.csv containing 400 observations, where each observation is actually a customer who bought,
cues.zh: 第一個是一樣的 Social_Network_Ads.csv 資料集，包含 400 筆觀測值，每筆觀測值都是一位顧客，

cues.en: yes or no, an SUV that is advertised on social networks.
cues.zh: 記錄他是否購買社群網路廣告中的 SUV。

cues.en: And for each of these customers you have the age, the estimated salaries.
cues.zh: 每位顧客都有年齡與預估薪資。

cues.en: So these are the two features, and with these two features, you will predict the dependent variable purchased, meaning whether or not the customers bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 這就是兩個特徵，利用它們來預測應變數 Purchased，也就是顧客是否購買 SUV。

cues.en: So one means yes, the customer bought a previous SUV, and zero means no, the customer didn't buy any SUV.
cues.zh: 1 代表是，顧客購買了 SUV；0 代表否，顧客沒有購買 SUV。

cues.en: All right, so same data set.
cues.zh: 好，還是相同的資料集。

cues.en: And, of course, the second file is this support_vector_machine implementation in the INYNB format, which can either open with Google Collaborator or Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 第二個檔案當然就是 support_vector_machine 的實作，格式為 IPYNB，可以用 Google Colaboratory 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟。

cues.en: And, as far as I'm concerned, I'm gonna open it with Google Collaborator but feel free to choose your favorite ID.
cues.zh: 我會用 Google Colaboratory 開啟，你可以選自己喜歡的 IDE。

cues.en: All right, so let's put that file here, actually here.
cues.zh: 好，把檔案放到這裡，實際上是這裡。

cues.en: And right now it is loading the notebook, laying it out and in a second we should have it open.
cues.zh: 現在正在載入筆記本並排版，稍後就會開啟。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: All right, so that's the whole support vector machine implementation.
cues.zh: 這就是完整的支援向量機實作。

cues.en: And of course, it is exactly the same as before.
cues.zh: 當然，和之前完全一樣。

cues.en: In order to reimplement this, we will only have to change the code sale where we build and train this model, because indeed, this implementation results
cues.zh: 要重新實作它，只需修改建立及訓練模型的程式碼儲存格，因為這份實作確實

cues.en: from the exact same classification template that we made when we built the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 來自建立邏輯斯迴歸模型時製作的同一份分類範本。

cues.en: We saw clearly when implementing the K nearest neighbors model, how indeed we only had to change one sale and how this template worked super well for that model.
cues.zh: 實作 K 最近鄰模型時我們清楚看到，只需改一個儲存格，這個範本就能非常順利地用於該模型。

cues.en: So here for SVM, we're gonna do exactly the same.
cues.zh: 所以 SVM 也要採取完全相同的作法。

cues.en: We're just gonna leave all the sales as they are as they actually were in the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 其他儲存格都保持原樣，和邏輯斯迴歸模型時相同。

cues.en: And we will only reimplement the sale where we build the SVM.
cues.zh: 只重新實作建立 SVM 的儲存格。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，開始吧。

cues.en: Let's create a new copy of this file because this file is in read only mode.
cues.zh: 先建立檔案副本，因為這個檔案是唯讀模式。

cues.en: So let's click here, save a copy and drive, and this will create a copy inside which we will indeed be able to modify the implementation and mostly to reimplement that code cell to
cues.zh: 點這裡的「在雲端硬碟中儲存副本」，就會建立可修改實作的副本，主要就是重新實作那個程式碼儲存格，

cues.en: build an SVM model.
cues.zh: 來建立 SVM 模型。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 好，太好了。

cues.en: So at the beginning, of course, we start with the data pre-pricing phase with all the same outputs displayed on the notebook.
cues.zh: 一開始當然是資料前處理階段，筆記本中顯示的輸出都一樣。

cues.en: So that's all good.
cues.zh: 這些都沒問題。

cues.en: Then we apply feature scaling because you know it improves the training performance .
cues.zh: 接著做特徵縮放，因為它能改善訓練效能。

cues.en: And anyway, it's never bad to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 而且做特徵縮放總不會有壞處。

cues.en: And finally, there we go.
cues.zh: 最後，到了這裡。

cues.en: That's the sale we have to reimplement together because indeed it is the one that defers with respect to the previous implementations.
cues.zh: 這就是要一起重新實作的儲存格，因為它是與之前實作不同的地方。

cues.en: So let's click this trash button here to, you know, reimplement it again, let's create a new code sale.
cues.zh: 點這裡的垃圾桶按鈕，重新實作，再建立一個新的程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And now my friends, over to you.
cues.zh: 朋友們，現在交給你。

cues.en: Once again, I would like you to please press pause on the video and try to implement that code cell yourself.
cues.zh: 再次請你暫停影片，試著自己實作這個儲存格。

cues.en: And that's because I not only want to train you in machine learning, but also train you on how to be independent with machine learning.
cues.zh: 因為我不只想訓練你的機器學習能力，也想讓你能獨立運用機器學習。

cues.en: So right now, the exercise I want you to do is to do some research in the cycle learn API to figure out which class allows to build the SVM model.
cues.zh: 現在要做的練習，是到 scikit-learn API 查資料，找出哪個類別能建立 SVM 模型。

cues.en: So you will find it very easily, actually, because there is no trap in the name of the class or the name of the module.
cues.zh: 其實很容易找到，類別或模組名稱沒有陷阱。

cues.en: So I trust you will totally be able to do this exercise successfully and mostly know which method to use at the end to train that SVM model on the training set.
cues.zh: 我相信你一定能成功完成練習，尤其是知道最後要用哪個方法，在訓練集上訓練 SVM 模型。

cues.en: All right, so please press pause, and now in two seconds I'm gonna give you the solution.
cues.zh: 好，請暫停，兩秒後我就會提供解答。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，開始。

cues.en: So I already have the sklearn API opened, you know, that was for the nearest neighbors, the K nearest neighbors, which we implemented previously in the previous section.
cues.zh: 我已經開啟 sklearn API，先前是用來找上一節實作的 K 最近鄰。

cues.en: We use this class, K neighbors classifier.
cues.zh: 我們使用了 KNeighborsClassifier 類別。

cues.en: And now the next thing we would like to find in this API documentation is the module that contains the class that allows to build the SVM model.
cues.zh: 現在要在 API 文件中找出包含建立 SVM 模型所需類別的模組。

cues.en: So naturally, where could we find it?
cues.zh: 自然會在哪裡找到呢？

cues.en: You know, here, should we scroll back up or scroll down?
cues.zh: 這裡應該往上捲還是往下捲？

cues.en: Well, let's hope that you know the name of the module starts with an S, because here, you know, the modules are organized by alphabetical order.
cues.zh: 希望你想到，模組名稱應該以 S 開頭，因為這裡的模組按字母順序排列。

cues.en: So since here we are at N, Nearest Neighbors, let's hope that the name of the module we're looking for starts with an S, like support vector machine.
cues.zh: 既然目前在 N，也就是 Nearest Neighbors，我們就期待要找的模組以 S 開頭，像 Support Vector Machine。

cues.en: So let's scroll down.
cues.zh: 往下捲。

cues.en: And random projections, semi-supervised learning, and there we go.
cues.zh: Random Projections、Semi-supervised Learning，找到了。

cues.en: Support vector machines. Hello.
cues.zh: Support Vector Machines，你好。

cues.en: That's exactly what we were looking for.
cues.zh: 這正是我們要找的。

cues.en: Support vector machines.
cues.zh: 支援向量機。

cues.en: So that's not the name of the module.
cues.zh: 不過這不是模組名稱。

cues.en: The name of the module is SVM, that same- that stands for Support Vector Machines.
cues.zh: 模組名稱是 svm，代表 Support Vector Machines。

cues.en: All right, and then, well, you know, the hardest part is done.
cues.zh: 好，最困難的部分已經完成。

cues.en: Now according to you, which estimator is, you know, because here you have all the basically support vector machines based machinery models.
cues.zh: 你認為應該用哪個估計器？這裡基本上列出所有以支援向量機為基礎的機器學習模型。

cues.en: And so according to you, which one do we need to take here?
cues.zh: 你認為該選哪一個？

cues.en: Well, we actually have two options.
cues.zh: 其實有兩種選擇。

cues.en: We could either take the linear SVC, which will directly build the linear support vector machine model, or we can take this one, SVC, and choose a linear kernel.
cues.zh: 可以選 LinearSVC，直接建立線性支援向量機模型；或選 SVC，再指定線性核心。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And we will actually go for this option because in the next section we will study the kernel SVM models which, as you might guess, allow us to choose some different kernels in our SVM,
cues.zh: 我們會選後者，因為下一節會研究核心 SVM 模型，你應該猜得到，它能讓我們為 SVM 選不同核心，

cues.en: including the linear one and the non-linear ones.
cues.zh: 包括線性核心與非線性核心。

cues.en: Like for example, the very famous one, RBF.
cues.zh: 例如非常有名的 RBF。
